methods_used: Elsevier Scopus Search API (ISSN 0144-8617, PUBYEAR>2023, sort=-coverDate, paged start/count 0..1700, 1725 records scanned)
PubMed E-utilities ESearch (Carbohydr Polym[ta] AND Journal Article[pt] NOT Review[pt], datetype=pdat, reldate=730) paged via retstart to retrieve all 2489 matching PMIDs
PubMed E-utilities EFetch (full record incl. abstract, pubtype, ArticleDate) for all 2489 PMIDs, batched ~150 per request
Cross-referenced against state/seen_articles.json to isolate unseen DOIs, sorted by ArticleDate descending
Excluded Retraction Notice / Corrigendum / Expression of Concern / Retracted Publication pubtypes and titles
Manually verified top unseen candidates abstract-by-abstract to exclude microbe-centric research (strain engineering, biosynthesis pathways, serology, fermentation optimization)

exclusion_summary.notes: Elsevier Scopus scan of the most recent ~1725 records (coverDate descending) showed the recent issues/Articles-in-Press are dominated by Review and Erratum/Corrigendum items; only 30 Article-subtype unseen candidates were found in that window, and abstract verification showed nearly all of those were either mislabeled reviews (per PubMed pubtype) or microbe-centric research articles (e.g. Bacillus smithii EPS biosynthesis, E. coli glycoconjugate vaccine engineering, Lactobacillus cell-wall/secreted polysaccharide switching, Corynebacterium glutamicum chondroitin production engineering, Proteus/Plesiomonas O-antigen serology, Aspergillus atacamensis cell wall biology, Sinorhizobium galactoglucan production, Streptococcus pneumoniae capsular polysaccharide vaccine purification). To find a genuine 20-article batch, a comprehensive PubMed ESearch/EFetch sweep of all 2489 non-review Journal Article records published in the last 2 years was performed and cross-checked against seen_articles.json; this surfaced a large backlog of materials-science articles from Aug 2025 that previous daily runs had not yet reached. From this backlog, mutansucrase/biofilm research (Streptococcus mutans virulence factor) was also excluded as microbe-centric, after which the next 20 unseen, non-review, non-retraction, non-microbe-centric articles (all dated 2025-08-08 to 2025-08-21) were selected.
excluded_microbe_centric_examples: Lipopolysaccharide of Plesiomonas shigelloides O68:H2 (O-antigen serology)
O-acetyl groups ... Proteus mirabilis O48 O-antigens (O-antigen serology)

Elucidating the metabolic network ... exopolysaccharides XY1-EPS in Bacillus smithii (bacterial biosynthesis pathway)
Mutations in PilZ domains of ... bacterial glucan synthases (bacterial enzyme/strain)
Switching cell wall-bound polysaccharides to secreted polysaccharides in lactobacilli (microbial strain biology)
Engineering Escherichia coli to biosynthesize O-polysaccharide-derived glycoconjugate vaccines (strain engineering)
Engineering compartmentalized utilization of glycerol ... chondroitin production in Corynebacterium glutamicum (strain/bioprocess engineering)
Production and functional characterization of ... galactoglucan G2 secreted by Sinorhizobium sp. ACT002 (strain isolation/production optimization)
Development ... capsular polysaccharide purification process from ... Streptococcus pneumoniae serotype 22F (vaccine antigen purification from pathogen)
Unraveling role of the glucan-binding domain in mutansucrase-mediated glucan synthesis and biofilm-related properties (bacterial virulence factor/biofilm)

notes: Elsevier Abstract/Article Retrieval API (api.elsevier.com/content/abstract/doi/...) returned only METADATA view (no abstract text, author list truncated); full abstracts, complete author lists, and PubMed Publication Type tags for review/retraction/pubtype classification were obtained via PubMed E-utilities EFetch instead. ArticleTitle text was extracted with itertext() to correctly capture titles containing <sub>/<sup> markup (e.g. Ag/MnO2).
